method: Original fixed::observe core linked to one checked LLVM object per executable. Copied caller source changes only mod fixed to pub mod fixed for a stdout-witness test harness. Public production caller is unchanged.
limits: Original CLI /out witness publication, sync/stdout failure paths, hostile-host filesystem stability, arbitrary native memory safety and Cranelift native-caller support are not established. Witness call counts describe the source path and were not checked by an independent external call counter. Separate same-maintainer review, not independent review.
